complaint_text: Bijli nahi aa rahi Sector G-9 Islamabad mein last 8 hours se. IESCO helpline does not pick the call.
No water in Street 7 F-11 since Monday. CDA tanker never comes to our block.
Garbage has not been collected from I-8 Markaz for four days. The smell is unbearable near the CDA office.
The residents of G-9 submitted a complaint about the transformer.
Illegal parking in front of Centaurus Mall is blocking the whole lane every evening.
PIMS emergency waiting time was more than 4 hours yesterday. A patient from Rawalpindi collapsed in the corridor.
Pipe burst on Khayaban-e-Iqbal near Melody Food Park. Water is wasting since 6am.
Meter reader from IESCO overcharged our house in G-10/3. Bill is 45000 which is impossible.
Sewerage overflow outside Faisal Mosque parking. Children from nearby school are falling sick.
Please tell me how to apply for a new commercial signboard license in Blue Area.
CDA water tanker did not reach Street 12 yesterday.
Signal at Faisal Avenue and Jinnah Avenue is not working. Traffic police are absent.
Polyclinic hospital pharmacy had no medicine for dengue patients today. Staff of Ministry of Health did not respond.
Transformer blast in Bari Imam last night. Whole village is in dark. Please send IESCO team.
Kachra wala nahi aaya G-6 mein 1 week se. Cats have torn the bags on the footpath.
Drinking water from the CDA filtration plant in F-8 is muddy. My child Ali had stomach pain.
Road blockage on Kashmir Highway due to a broken trailer. No diversion board.
Someone dumped medical waste behind PIMS hostel.
Load shedding in Tarnol is 12 hours daily. IESCO says rural feeder but we pay urban tariff.
Lady doctor at BHU Koral was on leave and no replacement came. Women from nearby villages waited till noon.
I want to thank the sanitation crew of Sector E-11. They cleaned the nullah before Eid.
No pressure in overhead tank of Street 22 G-13. CDA line is leaking in front of Masjid-e-Aqsa.
Double parking by diplomatic cars near the embassy in Diplomatic Enclave. Local vans cannot pass.
Sparking wires over the playground in I-9. A child almost got injured. IESCO please inspect today.
Open manhole on Service Road South near Karachi Company. Two motorbikes fell yesterday.
Dengue spray was not done in Ali Pur this month. Last year we had 9 cases.
Traffic police blocked the I-8 underpass during peak hours.
Hand pump in katchi abadi near Golra Sharif is dry. Women walk 2 km for water.
New connection requested 3 months ago by Mr Ahmed Khan of House 14 Street 9 G-11. IESCO file is lost.

complaint_text: When will the metro bus start operating till Peshawar Morr again? Schedule is not online.
Dead animal on the road in Bari Imam bazaar for two days. Health risk for the shrine visitors.
FGSH hospital discharge papers of Ms Sara Bibi were mixed with another patient.
IESCO staff replaced the meter but billing is still wrong.
Filtration plant of CDA at F-10 Markaz is closed every Friday without notice.
School vans of Headstart are parking on the zebra crossing in F-7.
Nullah in I-10 is choked with plastic. After rain the water entered shops of Mr Naveed.
Voltage fluctuation damaged the fridge of a clinic in Kahuta Road. Who will compensate?
Ambulance from 1122 took 40 minutes to reach Bhara Kahu. The operator said no vehicle was free.
WASA-style billing error: we are in Islamabad but received a Rawalpindi water bill at House 5 Street 3 E-7.
Can IMH share the WhatsApp number of the Director Sanitation? Our union council chairman Mr Bilal wants a meeting.
